reviews.x: Many sunscreens claim to be “glowy not greasy” but this is the first hydrating chemical sunscreen I’ve ever used that doesn’t leave a thick greasy layer all over my face. The thickness is comparable to heavy cream, like a very milky lotion but not too watery and it goes on so easily. I would recommend moisturizing before applying as it isn’t hydrating enough on its own, but it fits perfectly into my skincare routine and is great for reapplying throughout the day without building up too much.

I love that it's not goopy at all. This works great for me layered over a moisturizing essence. For people with dryer skin, they would likely need to layer this over a regular cream for more moisture. Japanese skincare is the best and I'm so glad this is available on Amazon!

reviews.t: Third Party Tested - Great for Oily
reviews.x: This is a third party tested sunscreen. The results WERE less than 50spf, they were 44SPF which is still well above the recommended 30SPF.  The smell is a bit much to get used to. It smells strongly of alcohol at first but the smell dissipates within a few seconds after application.  What keeps me coming back to this sunscreen is that it does wonders for my oily skin. It keeps me moisturized while not greasy.

I don't understand why people go for expensive sunscreen in Sephora while this product hits all the marks.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the lightweight, non-greasy, watery texture that dries down without feeling heavy.
Many reviewers say it works well for oily and acne-prone skin, though some note it is not moisturizing and can be drying for dry skin.
A common complaint is the noticeable alcohol scent on application.
Several reviewers highlight good value for the size/price, though one reviewer complains about a price increase.
Some reviewers report eye and mouth irritation, especially for sensitive skin.
